Because an ordinary one-factor between-subjects ANOVA with no covariates or repeated measures partitions total sum of squares strictly as SS_total = SS_factor + SS_error, ordinary eta-squared (etasq) and partial eta-squared are algebraically identical (SS_factor / SS_total = SS_factor / (SS_factor + SS_error) = 0.08), confirming shipped 0.08.
